ex.en: Everything went smoothly.
ex.zh: 一切進行得很順利。

ex.en: I do hope everything will go smoothly.
ex.zh: 我真心希望一切順利。

ex.en: In order to move the project along smoothly, we have revised the plan several times.
ex.zh: 為了讓專案順利進行，我們已經修改計畫好幾次了。

smoothly.en: in a way that has no problems or difficulties

ex.en: This car is running less smoothly than it used to.
ex.zh: 這輛車跑起來沒有以前那麼順了。

ex.en: She speaks English smoothly and confidently.
ex.zh: 她說英文流暢又有自信。

smoothly.en: in a way that is even, without sudden stops or changes

ex.en: The police arrested him for smuggling.
ex.zh: 警方以走私罪名逮捕了他。

ex.en: He smuggled snacks into the movie theater.
ex.zh: 他偷偷把零食帶進電影院。

smuggle.en: to take goods or people into or out of a place secretly and illegally

ex.en: This room is too small to contain 50 men.
ex.zh: 這個房間太小，容納不了五十個人。

ex.en: The taxi I took was very old and small.
ex.zh: 我搭的那輛計程車又老又小。

ex.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
ex.zh: 水星是太陽系中最小的行星。

ex.en: Europe has a smaller population than Asia.
ex.zh: 歐洲的人口比亞洲少。

ex.en: There's a small problem with the order.
ex.zh: 這筆訂單有個小問題。

small.en: not large in amount, number or scale

ex.en: This girl is always smiling, but she's not happy.
ex.zh: 這個女孩總是在微笑，但她並不快樂。

ex.en: I don't like the way he smiles.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡他笑的樣子。

ex.en: When I thought of that, I couldn’t help smiling.
ex.zh: 想到這件事，我忍不住笑了。

smile.en: to make a happy look by turning up the corners of your mouth

ex.en: She saw her mother and gave a little smile.
ex.zh: 她看見媽媽，露出了淺淺的微笑。

ex.en: She greeted every customer with a smile.
ex.zh: 她面帶微笑迎接每一位客人。

smile.en: a happy look on your face with the corners of your mouth turned up

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你抽太多菸了，應該少抽一點。

ex.en: My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸一天抽一包菸。

ex.en: Tom never used to smoke, but he does now.
ex.zh: 湯姆以前從不抽菸，但現在會了。

smoke.en: to breathe in the fumes of burning tobacco from a cigarette

ex.en: There was smoke coming from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房冒出了煙。

ex.en: The room was full of smoke.
ex.zh: 房間裡充滿了煙。

smoke.en: the gray or black cloud that rises from something burning

ex.en: This smells great! What are you cooking?
ex.zh: 聞起來好香！你在煮什麼？

ex.en: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
ex.zh: 我討厭衣服有菸味。

ex.en: I don't like the way this fruit smells.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡這種水果的味道。

ex.en: Come and smell these flowers.
ex.zh: 過來聞聞這些花。

ex.en: Can you smell something burning?
ex.zh: 你有沒有聞到燒焦的味道？

smell.en: to notice or sense something with your nose

ex.en: I've smelled this smell somewhere before.
ex.zh: 我以前在哪裡聞過這個味道。

ex.en: I love the smell of fresh coffee.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡剛煮好的咖啡香。

smell.en: the quality of something that you notice with your nose

ex.en: He is not as smart as his older brother.
ex.zh: 他沒有他哥哥那麼聰明。

ex.en: I'm not as smart as I thought I was.
ex.zh: 我沒有自己以為的那麼聰明。

ex.en: You're a lot smarter than Tom and Mary are.
ex.zh: 你比湯姆和瑪麗聰明多了。

smart.en: able to learn and understand things quickly

ex.en: I control the lights with my smart speaker.
ex.zh: 我用智慧音箱控制電燈。

ex.en: Smart devices make our homes more convenient.
ex.zh: 智慧裝置讓我們的家更方便。

smart.en: able to connect to the internet and work in an advanced way

ex.en: You look very smart in that suit.
ex.zh: 你穿那套西裝看起來很體面。

ex.en: Staff must wear smart clothes when meeting clients.
ex.zh: 員工和客戶見面時必須穿著得體。

smart.en: clean, neat and fashionable in appearance

ex.en: Her skin is smooth.
ex.zh: 她的皮膚很光滑。

ex.en: This scarf feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 這條圍巾摸起來又軟又滑。

smooth.en: having a flat surface with no rough parts

ex.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
ex.zh: 重新設計的使用者介面讓玩家在各種裝置上都能玩得更流暢。

ex.en: We hope for a smooth transition to the new system.
ex.zh: 我們希望能順利轉換到新系統。

smooth.en: happening easily without problems or sudden changes

ex.en: I'm looking for a smartphone with a good camera.
ex.zh: 我想找一支相機好用的智慧型手機。

ex.en: I still don't have a smartphone.
ex.zh: 我還是沒有智慧型手機。

ex.en: You can check in for your flight on your smartphone.
ex.zh: 你可以用智慧型手機辦理登機報到。

smartphone.en: a mobile phone that can use the internet and run many programs

ex.en: I hate people who make small talk in quiet public places.
ex.zh: 我最討厭在安靜的公共場所閒聊的人。

ex.en: I'm not good at small talk with people I just met.
ex.zh: 我不擅長跟剛認識的人寒暄。

small talk.en: polite conversation about things that are not important

ex.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
ex.zh: 現在每個人都對天花免疫了。

ex.en: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.
ex.zh: 他們努力的目標是消滅天花。

ex.en: Smallpox was wiped out thanks to vaccines.
ex.zh: 多虧了疫苗，天花才被根除。

smallpox.en: a serious disease that causes a high fever and spots on the skin

ex.en: The ball smashed the window and landed on the floor.
ex.zh: 球打破了窗戶，掉在地板上。

ex.en: He accidentally smashed a glass while washing dishes.
ex.zh: 他洗碗時不小心打碎了一個杯子。

ex.en: We heard a loud smash from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們聽到廚房傳來一聲巨大的碎裂聲。

ex.en: The smash of the waves against the rocks was deafening.
ex.zh: 海浪猛撞岩石的聲音震耳欲聾。

ex.en: She won the point with a powerful smash.
ex.zh: 她用一記強力的殺球贏得這一分。

ex.en: His smash landed right at the back of the court.
ex.zh: 他的扣球正好落在球場底線。

ex.en: Smoking is not allowed inside the restaurant.
ex.zh: 餐廳內禁止吸菸。

ex.en: He quit smoking last year for his health.
ex.zh: 他去年為了健康戒菸了。

ex.en: Smith is one of the most common last names in English.
ex.zh: 史密斯是英語中最常見的姓氏之一。

ex.en: Mr. Smith teaches science at our school.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生在我們學校教自然科學。

ex.en: The village smith made horseshoes by hand.
ex.zh: 村裡的鐵匠用手工打造馬蹄鐵。

ex.en: A skilled smith can turn a metal bar into a beautiful tool.
ex.zh: 技藝純熟的工匠能把一根金屬棒變成漂亮的工具。

ex.en: The smiling waiter welcomed us to the restaurant.
ex.zh: 面帶微笑的服務生歡迎我們來到餐廳。

ex.en: She had a smiling face in every photo.
ex.zh: 她在每張照片裡都笑容滿面。

ex.en: My uncle has been a heavy smoker for years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔多年來一直是個老菸槍。

ex.en: The restaurant has a separate area for smokers.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有個專供吸菸者使用的區域。

ex.en: She smeared butter on the warm bread.
ex.zh: 她把奶油塗抹在溫熱的麵包上。

ex.en: The child smeared chocolate all over his face.
ex.zh: 小孩把巧克力抹得滿臉都是。

ex.en: The newspaper tried to smear the mayor's reputation.
ex.zh: 那份報紙企圖抹黑市長的名聲。

ex.en: Rivals smeared her with false rumors.
ex.zh: 對手用不實的謠言中傷她。

ex.en: There was a smear of oil on his shirt.
ex.zh: 他的襯衫上有一道油漬。

ex.en: Wipe the smear off the window with a cloth.
ex.zh: 用布把窗戶上的汙跡擦掉。

smoky.zh: 煙霧瀰漫的；有煙燻味的

ex.en: The room was smoky after the grill caught fire.
ex.zh: 烤架起火後，房間裡煙霧瀰漫。

ex.en: I love the smoky taste of grilled fish.
ex.zh: 我喜歡烤魚的煙燻味。

ex.en: My grandfather smoked a pipe every evening.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天晚上都會抽菸斗。

ex.en: She smoked for ten years before she finally quit.
ex.zh: 她抽了十年的菸才終於戒掉。

ex.en: We had smoked salmon on toast for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我們早餐吃了煙燻鮭魚吐司。

ex.en: The restaurant is known for its smoked ham.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以煙燻火腿聞名。

ex.en: The smuggler was caught at the border with hidden goods.
ex.zh: 走私者帶著藏起來的貨物在邊境被抓到。

ex.en: Old stories tell of a smuggler who hid tea in the cliffs.
ex.zh: 老故事提到一名把茶葉藏在懸崖裡的走私者。

ex.en: Firefighters used a blanket to smother the small fire.
ex.zh: 消防員用毯子悶熄了小火。

ex.en: She tried to smother a laugh during the serious meeting.
ex.zh: 在嚴肅的會議中，她努力忍住笑意。

ex.en: He was smartly dressed for the interview.
ex.zh: 他為面試穿得很體面。

ex.en: The guards saluted smartly as the president passed.
ex.zh: 總統經過時，衛兵俐落地敬禮。

ex.en: She smartly saved some money for emergencies.
ex.zh: 她聰明地存了一些錢以備急用。

ex.en: The team smartly changed its plan at halftime.
ex.zh: 球隊在中場休息時機靈地改變了策略。

ex.en: My gym bag is smelly after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽後我的運動包很臭。

ex.en: Take the smelly shoes outside, please.
ex.zh: 請把那雙臭鞋拿到外面去。

ex.en: He gave a smug smile after winning the argument.
ex.zh: 他在辯論贏了之後露出自鳴得意的微笑。

ex.en: Don't be so smug about your test score.
ex.zh: 別對你的考試成績那麼沾沾自喜。

ex.en: She sounded smug when she said she had been right all along.
ex.zh: 她說自己一直都是對的時，語氣很得意。

ex.en: Thick smog covered the city this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上濃濃的霧霾籠罩了這座城市。

ex.en: Smog makes it hard to breathe for some people.
ex.zh: 霧霾讓有些人呼吸困難。

ex.en: He was arrested for smuggling cigarettes across the border.
ex.zh: 他因為走私香菸越過邊境而被逮捕。

ex.en: Smuggling of rare animals is a serious problem.
ex.zh: 走私稀有動物是個嚴重的問題。

ex.en: He smirked when he saw me fail.
ex.zh: 他看到我失敗時得意地冷笑。

ex.en: She smirked and said, "I told you so."
ex.zh: 她得意地笑著說：「我早就告訴過你了。」

ex.en: A smirk appeared on his face after the joke.
ex.zh: 那個笑話說完後，他臉上露出一抹得意的笑。

ex.en: Wipe that smirk off your face.
ex.zh: 把你臉上那副得意的笑容收起來。

ex.en: In the legend, the hero smote the dragon with his sword.
ex.zh: 傳說中，英雄用劍重擊那條龍。

ex.en: The old story says the god would smite his enemies.
ex.zh: 古老的故事說那位神會懲罰他的敵人。

ex.en: The campfire smoldered all night after the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨後，營火整晚都在悶燒。

ex.en: Anger smoldered inside him, but he said nothing.
ex.zh: 他心裡怒火悶燒，卻什麼也沒說。

ex.en: The boys were smashing old plates at the recycling center.
ex.zh: 男孩們在回收中心砸著舊盤子。

ex.en: He was smashing the ice with a hammer to get at the bottle.
ex.zh: 他用鎚子敲碎冰塊，好拿出瓶子。

ex.en: We had a smashing time at the party last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在派對上玩得非常開心。

ex.en: That's a smashing idea, let's do it!
ex.zh: 這主意太棒了，我們就這麼做吧！

smashed.zh: 砸碎；打碎（smash 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The ball smashed the window of the neighbor's house.
ex.zh: 那顆球打碎了鄰居家的窗戶。

ex.en: He accidentally smashed his phone against the wall.
ex.zh: 他不小心把手機摔到牆上砸碎了。

ex.en: He was completely smashed after the party and couldn't walk straight.
ex.zh: 派對後他爛醉如泥，連路都走不直。

ex.en: They got smashed on a few drinks and sang loudly.
ex.zh: 他們喝了幾杯就醉了，還大聲唱起歌來。

ex.en: There was a black smudge on the white wall.
ex.zh: 白牆上有一塊黑色的污漬。

ex.en: I wiped a smudge off my glasses.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了眼鏡上的污漬。

ex.en: Don't smudge the wet paint with your sleeve.
ex.zh: 別用袖子把還沒乾的油漆蹭花了。

ex.en: Her pencil drawing smudged when she touched it.
ex.zh: 她一碰，鉛筆畫就暈開了。

ex.en: He has a smattering of French from a short trip.
ex.zh: 他因為一次短期旅行而略懂一點法文。

ex.en: A smattering of applause came from the audience.
ex.zh: 觀眾席傳來零星的掌聲。

ex.en: Most smallholders in the region grow rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 這個地區大部分的小農種植稻米和蔬菜。

ex.en: The government offered loans to local smallholders.
ex.zh: 政府向當地小農提供貸款。

ex.en: The painter wore an old smock covered in paint.
ex.zh: 畫家穿著一件沾滿顏料的舊罩衫。

ex.en: Children put on smocks before the art class.
ex.zh: 孩子們上美術課前先穿上罩衫。

ex.en: She bought a loose cotton smock for the summer.
ex.zh: 她為夏天買了一件寬鬆的棉質罩衫。

ex.en: Black smoke poured out of the factory smokestack.
ex.zh: 黑煙從工廠的煙囪冒出來。

ex.en: The tall smokestack could be seen from miles away.
ex.zh: 從好幾英里外都能看見那根高大的煙囪。

ex.en: I love the smoothness of this silk scarf.
ex.zh: 我喜歡這條絲巾的柔滑。

ex.en: Check the smoothness of the road before you ride your bike.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車前先看看路面是否平整。

ex.en: The smoothness of the flight surprised the nervous passengers.
ex.zh: 飛行的平穩讓緊張的乘客感到意外。

ex.en: The team praised the smoothness of the meeting.
ex.zh: 團隊稱讚這場會議進行得很順利。

ex.en: She has the smarts to solve this problem on her own.
ex.zh: 她有足夠的聰明才智可以自己解決這個問題。

ex.en: You need street smarts to travel alone in a big city.
ex.zh: 一個人在大城市旅行，需要有處世的機靈。

ex.en: The campfire continued to smoulder after midnight.
ex.zh: 營火在午夜之後仍在悶燒。

ex.en: Ashes smoulder for hours after a fire is put out.
ex.zh: 火被撲滅後，灰燼還會悶燒好幾個小時。

ex.en: The smoldering campfire was still warm in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上那堆悶燒的營火還是溫的。

ex.en: A smoldering anger showed in his eyes.
ex.zh: 他的眼中流露出隱隱燃燒的怒火。

ex.en: We rented a smallish apartment near the station.
ex.zh: 我們在車站附近租了一間偏小的公寓。

ex.en: He drove a smallish car that was easy to park.
ex.zh: 他開一輛偏小的車，很好停。

ex.en: We enjoyed a smorgasbord of fish, bread, and cheese.
ex.zh: 我們享用了有魚、麵包和起司的瑞典式自助餐。

ex.en: The hotel serves a smorgasbord every Sunday.
ex.zh: 這家飯店每週日都供應自助餐。

ex.en: The website offers a smorgasbord of free online courses.
ex.zh: 這個網站提供種類繁多的免費線上課程。

ex.en: The festival was a smorgasbord of music and art.
ex.zh: 這場節慶有各式各樣的音樂與藝術。

ex.en: When the price was so low, I began to smell a rat.
ex.zh: 價格低成那樣，我開始覺得事有蹊蹺。

ex.en: She smelled a rat when he refused to show his ID.
ex.zh: 他不肯出示證件，她就覺得不太對勁。

smell a rat.en: to suspect that something is wrong or dishonest
